source_review.notes: Checked RFC 9110 negotiation semantics, RFC 9111 cache matching and Vary behavior, and the current IANA media-types registry; every structured reference was reviewed.

evidence: Reviewed V, P, v*, authorized-candidate, and variant-attribute notation and all math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Every symbol is introduced in context and renders with supported delimiters.

evidence: Recomputed 3^10 as 59,049 and checked all stated quality-value comparisons.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The cross-product and worked preference comparisons were independently recomputed.

evidence: Checked that Selected(r) belongs to the authorization-filtered candidate set V_r under the stated procedure.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Selection definitions preserve the authorization-first ordering.

evidence: Examples cover absent Accept, q=0, wildcards, unavailable request media, omitted Vary, authorization, and cost tie-breaking.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Explicit rejection, absence, cache, and authorization boundaries were reviewed.

evidence: Checked authorization-first, metadata, cache-selection, and determinism invariants against Examples 3, 5, 8, and 9.
invariant_checking.notes: The invariants constrain implementation and cache policy without claiming universal correctness.

evidence: The executable example explicitly disclaims complete RFC parsing, caching, and authorization evidence.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Observed toy output is not generalized to production behavior.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed proactive, reactive, and request-content negotiation as distinct mechanisms and checked absent versus explicit preference semantics.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed cache poisoning, variant explosion, authorization leakage, compression cost, privacy, and stable tie-breaking concerns.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed progression from selection vocabulary and algorithm through ten distinct examples and five transfer-oriented exercises with complete answers.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
